status: GATE_NOT_MET — needle-law sub-gates all pass (prerequisite, 3/4 cell confirmation, ordering) but the pre-registered positive control (kv recall) fails decisively in all 4 cells, so the composite pre-registered pass_if is FALSE
positive_control_failure_root_cause: Identified from campaign.json, not newly investigated this tick: p1b's fix over p1a only mixed NEEDLE-format training examples (10% of each batch, data/train_needles.npy) into the stream to teach that task's output format. No equivalent KV-format examples were added. p1a's own finding (natural-text pretraining confers copying but not needle/kv retrieval without task-format training) therefore still applies to kv specifically in p1b -- kv distances are trivially short (max 27 tokens, inside every window) but the model was never shown the kv lookup-and-answer format at meaningful frequency, so it did not learn to perform the task at all, independent of window size. This is a design gap in p1b's own pre-registration (fixed for needle, not for kv), not a mechanism failure of the windowing law itself.
law_signal_summary: The window-provisioning law's needle-accuracy predictions hold up well on natural text where assessable: w128 and w256 confirm within ~0.011 of prediction, w1024 confirms exactly (0.0 error), and w512's apparent 0.186 miss is fully explained by a known, pre-documented boundary-convention artifact (its own re-scoring under the alternate convention confirms to within 0.014). Ordering holds cleanly across all 4 cells. However the composite pre-registered gate REQUIRES the positive control to also hold, and it does not -- so this campaign, taken as pre-registered, does NOT PASS and does not unlock Lab 2 Phase 2 funding under the 'gated on p1b passing' condition in OPERATOR.md's PROGRAM DIRECTION UPDATE.
recommendation_not_a_decision: A rerun with a KV-format training mix analogous to the needle fix (same 10% treatment, disjoint salt) would likely let the positive control pass and let the needle-law confirmation stand on a fully-validated instrument. This is a recommendation for Hani, not an authorized action -- no new cloud spend taken on it this tick.
